description: The takes recorded in the iPhone app and where each is filed: a planned post, a topic, B-roll (footage with no voice) or unfiled. Each take has the first words the phone heard, its length, and whether it is in the person's Photos library. Filter by folder, or search the words with query. The video stays on the phone: there is nothing here to download or watch. folders counts every folder's takes. File takes with take_file.

folder.description: Only the takes in this folder

id.description: The post's id for post, the topic's id for topic

kind.description: post: a planned post (id); topic: a topic (id, or name to find or make one); broll: B-roll; unfiled: not filed

name.description: topic only, in place of id: the topic with this name, made when there is none

limit.description: At most this many, newest first (default 50)

query.description: Only takes whose words contain this

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: takes_list
title: List the phone's takes
